A Snapshot of Your Day

Join us in shaping the future of offshore wind. As our Traverse Equipment Owner, you will serve as the technical authority and lifecycle owner for traverse equipment used in offshore installation and servicing operations. You will be responsible for ensuring equipment performance, reliability, safety, and long-term value across a global fleet.

Working at the intersection of engineering, operations, project execution, suppliers, and management, you will play a key role in aligning diverse stakeholder needs and translating them into clear requirements, priorities, and improvement initiatives. Success in this role requires strong stakeholder management capabilities, sound technical judgement, and the ability to balance operational, commercial, and safety considerations.

You will drive the development of the traverse equipment roadmap, monitor fleet performance, and lead continuous improvement efforts throughout the equipment lifecycle. By fostering collaboration, standardization, and the adoption of new technologies, you will help ensure that our traverse solutions continue to support safe and efficient offshore operations worldwide.

How You’ll Make an Impact

• Own the traverse equipment lifecycle, ensuring optimal performance, reliability, safety, and long-term business value.

• Translate operational and stakeholder needs into clear requirements, success criteria, and approved improvement initiatives.

• Develop and maintain the traverse equipment roadmap and prioritized backlog, including technology development and investment needs.

• Monitor fleet performance, assess incidents and lessons learned, and drive corrective actions, upgrades, and risk mitigation measures.

• Promote knowledge sharing, technical excellence, and the adoption of innovative technologies across the Equipment organization.

What You Bring

• An Engineering degree (Mechanical, Marine, Civil, Industrial, or similar) and at least 10 years of technical experience in equipment development, maintenance, or asset management within offshore wind or a comparable heavy-industry environment.

• Proven experience with traverse systems, lifting equipment, stabilization systems, motion control technologies, or other equipment used for offshore heavy-load handling.

• Demonstrated experience in equipment ownership, technical leadership, or lifecycle management of complex engineered products.

• Ability to convert operational challenges and user feedback into technical requirements, validation criteria, and improvement plans.

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with a structured, proactive, and solution-oriented approach.

About the Team

You will join a global team responsible for the development, maintenance, and continuous improvement of specialized offshore equipment. The team combines operational experience with engineering expertise to ensure equipment reliability, safety, and efficiency throughout its lifecycle. Together, we drive innovation, standardization, and best practices that support offshore wind projects worldwide.

Who is Siemens Gamesa?

Siemens Gamesa is part of Siemens Energy, a global leader in energy technology with a rich legacy of innovation spanning over 150 years. Together, we are committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. As a leading player in the wind industry and manufacturer of wind turbines, we are passionate about driving the energy transition and providing innovative solutions that meet the growing energy demand of the global community. At Siemens Gamesa, we are constantly seeking individuals to join our team and support our focus on energy transformation. Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Gamesa: https://www.siemens-energy.com/global/en/home/careers/working-with-us.html

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by multiple nationalities. We celebrate character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Rewards/Benefits

• Opportunities to work with a global team

• Medical benefits

• Remote/Flexible work

• Paid holidays and parental leave

• Employer-funded pension

• Subsidised lunch and more

Are you motivated to drive and support the commercial management agenda of a leading telco organization within our core broadband team?

If so, please apply to join our vibrant and energetic High-Speed team within the Commercial Management Business Unit and help us shape our customer base management strategies and programs across our high-speed technologies.

TDC NET is on a journey to reshape the telco industry and to become a global example of transformation within the industry. Our goal is to build a future-proof infrastructure that can improve people's lives across Denmark.

About the job

You will own performance analytics across our fiber and coax customer base and products, turning data into insights that drive growth, retention and better customer outcomes. You will help design new products and propositions and manage cross-functional initiatives that improve customer experience and improve how we manage TDC NET’s customer base.

This is a role that makes a clear difference. You will drive change and help develop our primary revenue stream at a time when the broadband market is evolving fast.

This position reports to the Head of High-Speed and will work directly with senior members of the TDC NET organization, including the Senior Director of Commercial Management, VP of Sales, and other top executives.

Primary Responsibilities

• Manage the performance of the High Speed customer base across fiber and coax, including KPIs, reporting and performance reviews

• Analyse the fiber and coax customer base in depth to find growth, retention and migration opportunities

• Own and lead customer- and product-focused commercial initiatives from idea to implementation

• Build business cases and commercial models for new initiatives, assessing impact on revenue and long-term growth

• Lead cross-functional project teams and coordinate with stakeholders across TDC NET and wholesale partners

• Prepare decision material and present recommendations to senior management and steering committees

“In our team, you’re trusted with responsibility from day one. The pace is high, decisions are taken quickly, and you’re encouraged to question how we do things. That creates an environment where you grow fast and see your ideas come to life”, says Mads Clausen, Marketing Manager

About you

We are looking for a dedicated and skilled professional with a relevant master’s degree in fields such as Business, Economics, Finance, Natural Sciences (or other fields with relevant subsequent experience). You bring:

• Experience from top-tier consulting or a commercial role in the industry. Previous work in telecommunications is advantageous but not mandatory

• Extensive “consultancy toolbox”, including advanced analytical skills, structure problem-solving approach, proficiency in PPT for communicating in-depth data analysis into simple and understandable slides

• Deep business insights and the ability to identify and prioritize key value creation levers

• Ease in working in technical territories and interest to learn about processes within TDC NET

• Fluency in English is required

The High-Speed team has recently been established as part of our high-speed broadband simplification efforts. We believe that the success of our team is based on close collaboration within the team, and the ability to effectively negotiate priorities and drive agendas with other parts of the TDC NET organization. That’s why we are very delighted to welcome a positive and collaborative voice to join our team," says Maria Moro, Head of High Speed

Contact:

If you have questions about the position or want to know more about what it means to work at TDC NET, feel free to reach out to Maria Moro, Head of High Speed, on mmoro@tdcnet.dk

We look forward to reviewing your application and potentially welcoming you to our team at TDC NET.

We are looking forward hearing from you!

At Vattenfall, the mission is as bold as it is vital: to enable fossil-free living within one generation. To lead the transition into tomorrow, Vattenfall knows that cutting-edge technology alone isn't enough - they are genuinely eager to welcome new generations of talent who bring fresh eyes, bold curiosity, and modern perspectives.

About the role

Imagine knowing that the data streams you monitor and the edge devices you configure directly ensure offshore wind turbines across Europe deliver clean power to millions of homes.

Reaching climate goals and building a fossil-free future requires diverse viewpoints, continuous curiosity, and genuine teamwork. At Vattenfall, they don't expect you to arrive with all the answers on day one; they are just as excited to learn from your ideas as they are to help you grow into an exceptional engineer.

On behalf of Vattenfall, Academic Work is looking for a committed early-career engineer to join the Digital Engineering (OT SCADA) team in Kolding. This is a 1-year full-time employment through Academic Work, where you will work on-site and integrated as an essential part of the team at Vattenfall. As part of a close-knit group of five engineers, you will collaborate closely with experienced colleagues on both project integrations and daily operations.

Alongside your core team responsibilities, you will continuously take part in a cross-functional graduate AI implementation project together with other graduates - giving you an instant peer network and the opportunity to create tangible, real-world impact across Vattenfall. You will step into a work environment with high trust, flexibility, dedicated mentorship, and a strong focus on your long-term personal and professional well-being.

At Vattenfall, they foster a culture built on trust, well-being, and balance. For them, it is not just about reaching our goals, but very much about how they reach them:

• Supportive community & mentorship: A thorough, safe onboarding alongside dedicated mentors and colleagues to give your career the strongest possible start.

• Inclusive environment: An open environment where you can ask questions, challenge existing ways of working, learn from mistakes, and share ideas from day one.

• Flexibility with respect for your life: A 37-hour working week with weekly work-from-home options and flexible hours, giving you the trust and freedom to balance career and personal life.

Work tasks

In this role, you will be integrated into large-scale, international renewable energy projects - from engineering and testing to ongoing operations and lifecycle improvements. Your main focus will be driving and supporting business-critical data collection via industrial edge devices, ensuring reliable data for decisions and market operations. You will never face challenges alone, but always have experienced teammates by your side.

Your main focus areas include:

• Edge Device & Gateway Integration: Configuring, deploying, and supporting industrial edge devices, connectors, and operational data pipelines.

• Problem Solving & Observability: Diagnosing incidents, performing root-cause investigations, and implementing improvements that prevent future data interruptions.

• Upgrades & Testing: Planning component upgrades and taking part in commissioning checks, including factory and site acceptance testing (FAT/SAT).

• Documentation & Standardization: Helping develop and document repeatable technical work packages, guidelines, and configuration runbooks.

• Cross-Border Collaboration: Working alongside interdisciplinary, international teams characterized by open knowledge sharing and daily mutual support.

We are looking for someone who:

• Is a recent graduate or has approximately up to 2 years of post-graduation experience.

• Holds a Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation/Control Engineering, Computer Engineering, Technical Computer Science, Industrial IT, or a related discipline.

• Brings a structured, analytical mindset to troubleshooting and an eagerness to understand root causes rather than just treating symptoms.

• Has a proactive sense of ownership, clear communication regarding risks and dependencies, and a desire to document and share knowledge.

• Thrives in an inclusive, interdisciplinary environment where people listen to each other's ideas and learn together.

• Speaks and writes fluent English (Vattenfall’s corporate language). Danish is an advantage, but not a requirement.

It is an advantage if you:

• Have had study-relevant experience, internships, or thesis projects focusing on renewable energy assets, SCADA systems, or OT/IT integrations.

• Are familiar with industrial edge computing, network protocols, industrial communication gateways, or data pipeline concepts.

Our recruitment process

The recruitment process is managed by Academic Work, and it is our client's wish that all inquiries regarding the position are directed to Academic Work.

Our selection process is ongoing, and the job posting may close before the recruitment process is completed if we advance to the next phase. The process includes two tests: a personality assessment and a cognitive test. These tests serve as tools to find the right talent for the right role and ensure equal opportunity, diversity, and a fair evaluation process.

Do You Feel a Match?

Even if you don't feel you check every single technical box, we still encourage you to apply! Both we at Academic Work and the team at Vattenfall value your potential, your curiosity, and your drive to learn just as much as your specific experience.

VATTENFALL A/S

Vattenfall is one of Europe's largest producers and retailers of electricity and heat. Vattenfall’s main purpose is to enable fossil-free living within one generation. The company employs approximately 20,000 people and primarily operates in Sweden, Germany, the Netherlands, Denmark, and the UK.

Vattenfall works actively to build a more attractive and diverse workplace where all employees have equal rights and opportunities regardless of background, and where everyone's contribution is valued.

jobs.occupation: Senior Data Engineer – Build the Data Foundation for Greener Rail
jobs.description:
Cubris · A Hitachi Rail company · Ballerup, Denmark · On-site with flexibility

Would you like to use your expertise in Python, geospatial data and data platforms to make rail operations smarter and more energy-efficient? At Cubris, you will play a central role in developing the data foundation behind solutions that help train operators reduce energy consumption and improve punctuality.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Data Engineer who enjoys shaping technical direction, building solutions and working closely with colleagues across engineering, architecture and product.

Your role

You will help shape the data platform and geospatial model supporting our GreenSpeed® platform and Infrastructure Management System. You will turn complex railway data into a consistent, reliable foundation for our software – covering everything from tracks, signals and stations to gradients, speed limits and temporary restrictions.

Your main responsibilities will be to:

• 
Develop our data platform and geospatial model: Define schemas, feature classes, linear referencing using track and chainage, topology rules and railway asset attributes.

• 
Build robust Python data pipelines: Ingest, transform and integrate data, and automate workflows using Airflow or similar orchestration tools.

• 
Develop spatial storage and cloud solutions: Work with PostgreSQL/PostGIS or equivalent technologies, preferably on Microsoft Azure, and apply graph-based structures where they add value.

• 
Ensure data quality and traceability: Validate geometries, topology and attributes, and document data models and workflows with appropriate versioning and change control.

• 
Translate requirements into practical solutions: Collaborate with architects, software engineers, product managers and DevOps to deliver solutions that meet today’s needs and evolve with our products.

What you bring

You have substantial hands-on experience in data platform development and architecture, and you enjoy both making technical decisions and implementing them.

We are particularly interested in your:

• 
Strong Python skills and experience with scalable data pipelines, data integration and orchestration tools such as Airflow.

• 
Experience with GeoPandas, Shapely, GDAL/OGR, PyProj or equivalent geospatial technologies, including LineString and MultiLineString geometries.

• 
Knowledge of PostgreSQL/PostGIS or other spatial databases.

• 
Experience developing cloud-native data solutions, preferably on Microsoft Azure.

• 
Ability to work independently when requirements are evolving and documentation is still taking shape.

We also welcome a strong engineering grounding in industrial systems. You may have developed this through your education or through experience in transport, manufacturing, energy or automation. You understand how software, data and physical infrastructure interact, and how to translate real-world assets and operating conditions into accurate data models. You also appreciate the demands for quality, reliability and traceability in systems used in daily operations.

Experience with QGIS or ArcGIS, graph-based data structures and algorithms, safety-critical systems, railway technology or EBuLa integration would be an advantage.

As a colleague, you share your knowledge, contribute ideas and enjoy solving problems with others. You can balance long-term technical quality with practical delivery.

Why join Cubris?

You will have a real say in technical decisions and product development in a company where ideas can quickly become action. Our flat, agile organisation encourages open dialogue and gives you room to take ownership.

You will join a small, autonomous team backed by Hitachi Rail’s international expertise and resources. Your work will serve a clear purpose: smarter rail operations with lower energy consumption and CO₂ emissions.

The role is based in Ballerup, Denmark. We value close collaboration in the office while offering flexibility.

About Cubris

Cubris is a Danish software company and has been part of Hitachi Rail since 2024. Our award-winning GreenSpeed® platform helps train operators optimise driving, reduce energy consumption and improve punctuality. We develop technology for Driver Advisory Systems (DAS), Automatic Train Operation (ATO) and advanced data analytics.

Interested in joining us?

We would love to hear about your experience, your ideas and what motivates you. Send us your application and CV, or get in touch if you would like to learn more about the role and life at Cubris.

Full-time PhD position(s) on conspiracy theories in political communication at the Digital Democracy Centre (5+3 or 4+4 scheme)

The Digital Democracy Centre (DDC) at the University of Southern Denmark, Odense, invites applications for one or more full-time PhD positions studying conspiracy theories in political communication as part of the German Research Foundation-funded research unit Beyond Crazy: Integrating Benefits into the Analysis of Conspiracy Beliefs.

The project examines how conspiracy theories are shared in political communication, how the media and the public respond to such content, and how politicians perceive conspiracy theories. The project combines qualitative and quantitative social science methods, including content analysis, interviews, and social scientific experiments.

We are looking for motivated candidates from communication, psychology, journalism, political science, sociology, or related disciplines who are interested in conducting high-quality research with societal relevance.

The position can be applied for under either the 5+3 or 4+4 PhD scheme. Employment is expected to start in April 2027 or soon thereafter, and the place of employment is Odense.

For full details about the position, eligibility requirements, PhD schemes and application process, please read the full job advertisement and apply via SDU's website.

Application deadline: 11th of December 2026, 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST)
